recent_excerpts: CISA added CVE-2026-110447, an OS command injection in Collabora Online's CODE server on Nextcloud, to its KEV catalog with a 2026-10-26 patch deadline for federal agencies.
CVE-2026-45408 (CVSS 9.0) in Dokku <0.38.2 lets authenticated users inject shell commands via crafted app names in git push operations. No public exploit yet.
CVE-2026-41089 is a critical Windows Netlogon RCE now reported as exploited in the wild, with Microsoft CNA scoring it CVSS 9.8.
